author: Inside Edition
description: Inside Edition caught up with spring breakers at Newark Airport and it seemed nothing was stopping them from getting away, even the prospect of endless lines at security. Even travel guru Pauline Frommer says go for it. Olivia, Maya, and London packed for five days in West Palm Beach. The turmoil in the world made an impact on their plans. The top spring break destinations this year are Orlando, Fort Lauderdale, and Miami while Rome, Paris, and Cancun are the top destinations overseas.
title: Spring Breakers Determined To Vacation Despite Long Lines At Airport

author: Inside Edition
description: Two high school students were charged with plotting to kill their classmate by slitting his throat. The suspects treated their arrest as if it was one big goof. They asked if they were going to be placed in the same jail, their outfits, how their mugshots were going to look, and continued to giggle. The 14-year-old and 15-year-old, charged as adults, have pleaded not guilty to attempted murder. A judge ordered them held without bond.
title: 2 Teens Charged With Attempted Murder Giggle On Their Way To Jail

author: Inside Edition
description: Los Angeles' winter heatwave could play havoc on Hollywood's Oscars ceremony. Los Angeles is dealing with a record-breaking 93 degrees Friday, with temperatures expected to hit around 85 degrees on Oscar Sunday. Inside Edition counted more than half a dozen large air conditioning systems pumping cool air onto the red carpet and an elaborate tent providing shade. Inside Edition got a sneak peak of the Governors Ball, where celebrities will be indulging after the big awards show.
title: Will This Year's Oscars Red Carpet Be The Hottest In History?

author: Inside Edition
description: An elderly man struggled up the front steps of a home with a bag in his hand to complete a delivery for Doordash. Britney Smith could not believe her eyes when she watched her doorbell camera. Smith put out a plea on Facebook to find the delivery man and it worked. Someone recognized the man as 78-year-old Richard Pulley. Pulley's wife suffers from kidney disease and relies on expensive medication, so Smith set up a GoFundMe. In just three days, it raised more than $550K and counting.
title: GoFundMe Raises Over $550K For Elderly Doordasher

author: Inside Edition
description: What happens when your satellite breaks down in space? It actually just stays there and continues to orbit the Earth. Unfortunately AAA doesn't service the area, but that's where a new startup company sees an opportunity. ClearSpace has built a spacecraft to act as a tow truck, tracking down dead satellites and grabbing them from orbit with a robotic claw. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Startup Creates Towing Service For Broken Space Satellites

author: Inside Edition
description: This workshop recreates human forms, but not for Hollywood movies or Madame Tussaud's museums. This is a prosthetics lab in Ukraine that helps to replace body parts for victims of the ongoing war with Russia. Taisiya Yarova is a prosthetist working in the Unbroken Rehabilitation Center in Lviv. She expertly measures patients to create new eyes, fingers, and facial features. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Ukrainian Woman Expertly Crafts Prosthetics For Victims Of Russian Conflict

author: Inside Edition
description: The live shot from the Tucson bedroom was one of many “Today” show appearances over the years from Nancy Guthrie. One of the show’s segments in 2013 was about how to make a bed with “hospital corners,” and Guthrie was called in.
title: Heartbreaking 2013 'TODAY' Footage Shows Nancy Guthrie In Her Bedroom #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Dramatic body camera video released by the Abington Police Department in Massachusetts shows the moment a police officer jumped into action and saved a woman’s life, after officials say she was experiencing a mental health crisis while standing on train tracks. The officer sprung into action quickly enough to get the woman off the tracks with seconds to spare as a train was arriving.
title: Bodycam Captures Cop Rescuing Woman Off Trains Tracks As Locomotive Arrives
